title: agentproto.lock — agentproto-lock/v1 (tree-wide app/pack lockfile)
description: Validates agentproto.lock, a plain YAML file (NOT frontmatter — no markdown body) at the tree root. Pins every AIP-53 app and AIP-64 pack installed anywhere in the tree to the exact version, source and attach point it resolved to, so `agentproto workspace check` can flag drift between WORKSPACE.md `apps:` version ranges and what is actually installed.

version.description: Exact resolved version — never a range. The range lives in the consuming WORKSPACE.md's `apps[].version`.

source.description: Where the .agentapp came from (file: path, registry URL, ...).

attach.description: Workspace id this install is scoped to (the `scopeId` passed to app_apply).

dataDir.description: Tree-relative path to this ATTACH's own data directory — one per attach point, never shared across attaches of the same app. Path confinement applies (AIP-34 §Path confinement): no leading `/`, no `..` segment; hosts MUST ALSO realpath-verify containment.
